g.text: | Invalid | Commands that can contact MCPJam exit `2` (`MANAGED_SETTINGS_INVALID`), naming the file and the problem. Nothing is se
nt to MCPJam or its telemetry. Other commands still run. |
The file is invalid when it is not JSON, when `version`, `apiUrl` or `lock` is missing or has the wrong type, when `version` is no
t `1`, when it has any other key, when it cannot be read, when `apiUrl` has credentials, a query or a fragment, or when `apiUrl` u
ses plain `http://` to a host other than a loopback address.
When `HTTPS_PROXY` or `HTTP_PROXY` is set (either case), the CLI process sends its `fetch` requests through the proxy and honors `
NO_PROXY`: MCPJam's API, model providers and MCP servers over HTTP. `HTTPS_PROXY` covers `https` destinations and `HTTP_PROXY` cov
ers `http` ones; with only `HTTP_PROXY` set, `https` requests use it too. `localhost`, `127.0.0.1` and `[::1]` always connect dire
ctly, so local MCP servers and the local Inspector keep working. A value without a scheme, such as `proxy.corp.com:8080`, means `h
ttp://`; a value that is not an http(s) URL is ignored with a warning. Two connections do not use the proxy yet: the relay connect
ion of `mcpjam cloud tunnel` and the `mcpjam oauth` debugging proxy.
The update check runs in a separate short-lived process that uses Node.js's own proxy support. On Node.js older than 22.21, or 24.
x older than 24.5, the check is skipped while a proxy is set rather than sent directly.
